en: Colorized illustration showing a riverside cityscape with a bridge over a wide river in the foreground, a hill densely covered with trees and crowned by fortifications and towers in the middle, and distant mountains under a pastel sky. Historic multi‑story buildings line the riverbank, and a prominent clock tower stands on the hillside. Printed text at the top left names the scene in German.
